name: Souk el Guebli (Djerba)
notes: Apr-Oct; very shallow flat lagoon on Djerba's south-east shore with kite clubs. Seagrass, low tide limits riding. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: La Seguia (Djerba)
notes: Apr-Oct; E-facing beach and shallow lagoon near Aghir, east Djerba. Swimmers in summer. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Filim Lagoon (Barr al Hikman)
notes: May-Sep SW khareef monsoon; huge shallow tidal lagoon opposite Masirah, remote camping, no services. Approximate position.

name: Kappalady Lagoon (Kalpitiya)
notes: May-Oct SW monsoon, Dec-Mar NE; small flat lagoon south of Kalpitiya, kite camps on the shore. Approximate position.

name: Ekas Bay (Lombok)
notes: Jun-Sep SE trades; bay on Lombok's south-east tip, reef and seaweed farms, boat traffic. Usual SE trade is side-off; gust rates it offshore.

name: Kuta (Lombok)
notes: Jun-Sep SE trades; S-facing bay at Mandalika, reef close in, ride at mid-high tide. Approximate position. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Mertasari (South Sanur, Bali)
notes: Jun-Sep SE trades; E-facing reef lagoon at the south end of Sanur, kite schools. Shallow coral at low tide. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Lakey Beach (Hu'u, Sumbawa)
notes: Jun-Sep SE trades; reef breaks off Lakey/Hu'u, shallow sharp reef, surfers. Experienced riders only. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Solastranden (Jaeren)
notes: W-facing sandy beach by Stavanger airport; best SW-NW. Cold water, airspace limits kite height. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Rewa (Cypel Rewski)
notes: Shallow Puck Bay off the Rewa sand spit, flat water, kite schools. Summer crowds, swimmers near the spit.

name: Parnu Beach
notes: S-facing shallow sandy bay, best S-SW. Swimming zone in summer; cold water, ice in winter. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Pirlanta Beach (Cesme)
notes: May-Oct N meltemi; N-facing beach west of Cesme town, kite centre. Gusty near the headlands. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Ka'banya (Velika Plaza, Ulcinj)
notes: Jun-Sep afternoon SW-W thermal; long SW-facing sand beach near Ada Bojana, kite centres. Swimmers in summer. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Svencele (Curonian Lagoon)
notes: Apr-Oct; shallow flat Curonian Lagoon shore with kite centre and wake park. Cold early season. Sectors from shore facing.

name: Burgas North Beach
notes: E-facing Black Sea beach in north Burgas with kite clubs. Port and swimmers nearby. Approximate position. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Trellis Bay (Beef Island, BVI)
notes: Nov-Jul E trades; sheltered bay beside the airport, moorings and boats. Keep clear of the runway approach. Sectors from shore facing.

name: Bois Jolan (Sainte-Anne)
notes: Dec-Jun E trades; shallow reef lagoon off Sainte-Anne, waist-deep water. Coral at low tide. Approximate position. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Anse Michel (Cap Chevalier)
notes: Dec-Jun E trades; E-facing reef lagoon at Cap Chevalier, Sainte-Anne, kite schools. Shallow coral, boats. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Cas-en-Bas
notes: Dec-Jun E trades; E-facing Atlantic bay near Gros Islet, kite school. Reef at the bay edges. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Kite Beach (Clifton, Union Island)
notes: Dec-Jun E trades; E-facing beach behind the reef at Clifton, Grenadines. Shallow coral, boats in the harbour. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Pigeon Point (Tobago)
notes: Dec-Jun E trades; reef-protected Bon Accord lagoon side of Pigeon Point. Shallow coral, park entry fee. Sectors from shore facing.

name: Playa Copal (Bahia Salinas)
notes: Nov-Apr strong NE Papagayo winds; Bahia Salinas near the Nicaragua border, kite schools. Gusty. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Lake Arenal (Tilaran)
notes: Nov-Apr strong E-NE trades down the lake; west-end launch near Tilaran. Gusty, fresh water, rocky shore. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Podersdorf am See (Neusiedl)
notes: Apr-Oct, best NW; shallow Lake Neusiedl east shore, beach fee, kite zone rules. Mud and reeds. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Vadu Beach
notes: Wild Black Sea beach in the Danube Delta reserve north of Constanta, Romania's main kite spot. Shallow, no services. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Oostende Oosteroever
notes: Kite zone east of the harbour; best W to NE. Strong tidal currents, zone rules, summer limits. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Burwood Beach (Falmouth)
notes: Dec-Jul NE-E trades; N-facing beach east of Falmouth with a kite school. Reef offshore. Sectors from shore facing.

name: Nonsuch Bay (Antigua)
notes: Dec-Jul E trades; reef-sheltered bay on Antigua's east coast, kite school at the resort. Coral, moorings. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Yyteri (Pori)
notes: Long W-facing sand beach on the Gulf of Bothnia, shallow water, best SW-NW. Cold water, ice in winter. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Vakarbulli (Riga)
notes: NW-facing sandy Gulf of Riga beach at Daugavgriva, Riga's main kite beach. Shallow, cold water. Approximate position. OSM-inferred sectors.

name: Rantum (Sylt)
notes: West-facing North Sea beach; SW-NW best. Strong currents, shorebreak, groynes. Use kite zone, lifeguard rules in summer.

name: Altenteil (Fehmarn)
notes: NW tip of Fehmarn; W-N winds. Shallow stony entry, nature reserve nearby, keep to kite zone.

name: Kalifornien (Schönberger Strand)
notes: Kiel Bay beach facing NNE; W-E via N. Groynes and summer bathing zones; kite outside swim areas. Approximate position.

name: Dahme
notes: East-facing Baltic beach; N-S via E. Groynes and busy summer beach; use designated kite area. Approximate position.

name: Warnemünde
notes: Wide Baltic beach W of harbour; W-NE winds. Ferry/shipping channel to E, stay clear of piers. Kite zone at west end.

name: Rerik (Salzhaff)
notes: Shallow Salzhaff lagoon, flat water for learning. Nature reserve areas off-limits; check local rules.

name: Borkum Nordstrand
notes: North Sea island beach; SW-N winds. Strong tidal currents and sandbanks; kite zone near Nordstrand. Approximate position.

name: Kniepsand (Amrum)
notes: Huge west-facing sand plain; S-N via W. Long walk to water at low tide, tidal currents. Approximate position.

name: IJmuiden (Kennemerstrand)
notes: Beach S of harbour pier; SW-N winds. Flat-ish lagoon inside at low tide. Stay away from pier and shipping channel.

name: Hoek van Holland
notes: Wide beach N of Nieuwe Waterweg pier; SW-NNE. Shipping channel at pier, keep clear. Kite zone signposted.

name: Zandmotor (Kijkduin)
notes: Artificial sand peninsula with shallow lagoon; SW-N winds. Lagoon good for learning. Approximate position.

name: Domburg
notes: NW-facing Walcheren beach; SW-NE via N. Groynes and strong tidal current. Kite W of town outside swim zone.

name: Cadzand-Bad
notes: NW-facing beach near Belgian border; SW-NNE. Groynes, tidal currents. Kite zone near Zwin side. Approximate position.

name: Makkum Beach
notes: IJsselmeer beach facing W; S-N via W. Fresh water, shallow near shore. Popular with schools in summer. Approximate position.

name: Petten
notes: West-facing North Sea beach by Hondsbossche dunes; SW-N. Shorebreak and currents. Approximate position.

name: Knokke-Heist
notes: NW-facing beach; SW-NNE. Kite zone restricted in summer season; groynes and tidal current. Approximate position.

name: De Panne
notes: Very wide NW-facing beach near French border; SW-NNE. Shallow at low tide. Kite zone rules apply in summer.

name: Løkken
notes: NW-facing North Sea beach; SW-N. Shorebreak and rip currents; cars on beach. Approximate position.

name: Agger Tange
notes: West-facing North Sea beach; S-N via W. Waves, strong currents, remote. Limfjord flat water nearby. Approximate position.

name: Søndervig
notes: West-facing North Sea beach; S-N via W. Sandbars, shorebreak and currents. Approximate position.

name: Amager Strandpark
notes: Copenhagen artificial lagoon beach facing E; N-S via E. Busy in summer, swim zones off-limits. Approximate position.

name: Jurata (Puck Bay)
notes: Hel Peninsula bay side, shallow flat water; SE-NW via SW. Schools in summer. Approximate position.

name: Dębki
notes: North-facing open Baltic beach; W-E via N. Waves in strong winds, sandbars. Approximate position.

name: Skrea Strand (Falkenberg)
notes: Long SW-facing Kattegat beach; SSE-NNW via W. Bathing zones in summer. Approximate position.

name: Tylösand (Halmstad)
notes: SW-facing Kattegat beach; SSE-NNW via W. Busy summer beach, keep clear of swimmers. Approximate position.

name: Ribersborg (Malmö)
notes: Shallow Øresund beach facing W; S-N via W. Very shallow far out, good for learning. Approximate position.

name: Old Hunstanton
notes: NW-facing Norfolk beach; SW-NE via N. Strong tides, wide sands at low water. Approximate position.

name: Lancing Beach
notes: South-facing shingle beach; ESE-WSW. Groynes, steep shingle; best mid to low tide. Approximate position.

name: Saunton Sands
notes: West-facing North Devon beach; S-N via W. Surf and surfers; strong tides near Taw estuary. Approximate position.

name: Aberavon Beach
notes: SW-facing beach on Swansea Bay; SE-NW via SW. Large tidal range. Approximate position.

name: Brean
notes: West-facing Bristol Channel beach; S-N via W. Huge tidal range, soft mud at low tide. Approximate position.

name: West Sands (St Andrews)
notes: ENE-facing Fife beach; NNW-SSE via E. Eden estuary currents at N end. Approximate position.

name: Aberdeen Beach
notes: East-facing North Sea beach; N-S via E. Groynes, cold water, harbour entrance to S. Approximate position.

name: Benone Strand
notes: Long north-facing NI beach; W-ENE via N. Wide sands, beach access by car. Approximate position.

name: Tramore
notes: South-facing bay beach; E-W via S. Surf, back strand estuary currents to E. Approximate position.

name: Rossnowlagh
notes: West-facing Donegal beach; S-N via W. Atlantic swell and surfers. Approximate position.

name: Portmarnock (Velvet Strand)
notes: East-facing Dublin beach; N-S via E. Long sandy strand, busy on summer weekends. Approximate position.

name: Wimereux
notes: West-facing Channel beach; S-N via W. Strong tides, rocks at low tide. Approximate position.

name: Le Touquet
notes: Wide west-facing Opal Coast beach; S-N via W. Big tidal range, Canche estuary currents to N. Approximate position.

name: Malo-les-Bains (Dunkerque)
notes: North-facing beach E of Dunkerque harbour; W-E via N. Port traffic W, keep to kite zone. Approximate position.

name: Ouistreham (Riva-Bella)
notes: North-facing Normandy beach; W-E via N. Ferry channel at Orne mouth to E; tidal. Approximate position.

name: Lacanau-Océan
notes: West-facing Atlantic beach; S-N via W. Powerful shorebreak and rips; summer swim zones. Approximate position.

name: La Tranche-sur-Mer
notes: SSW-facing Vendée beach; ESE-WNW via S. Summer bathing restrictions. Approximate position.

name: Alvor (Ria de Alvor)
notes: Summer W-SW sea breeze side-on; tidal currents near the ria mouth. Approximate position.

name: Fuseta (Ria Formosa)
notes: Lagoon flat water in W-SW thermal; shallow at low tide, strong tidal flow in channels. Approximate position.

name: Praia de Faro
notes: Ocean side of Ilha de Faro; W-SW summer sea breeze side-shore. Swimmers in summer. Approximate position.

name: Cabedelo (Figueira da Foz)
notes: Summer N nortada side-shore; Atlantic swell, cold water, currents near the Mondego mouth. Approximate position.

name: Praia de Ofir (Esposende)
notes: Summer N nortada side-shore; open Atlantic beach, rocks offshore, cold water. Approximate position.

name: Lagoa de Santo André
notes: Coastal lagoon flat water in summer N nortada; level depends on the sea opening. Approximate position.

name: Zahara de los Atunes
notes: Poniente W side-on; Levante blows side-off here and is not rated. Summer bathing zones. Approximate position.

name: Valdelagrana (El Puerto de Santa María)
notes: Bay of Cádiz beach; Poniente W onshore. Levante offshore. Summer kite zone rules. Approximate position.

name: Cabo de Gata (Playa de San Miguel)
notes: Poniente SW-W side-on; Levante is side-off on this shore. Long open beach. Approximate position.

name: Playa de la Misericordia (Málaga)
notes: Levante E and Poniente W side-shore; terral N wind is offshore. Busy city beach in summer. Approximate position.

name: El Pinet (Santa Pola)
notes: E-SE sea breeze onshore, NE side-shore; W poniente offshore. Kite zone outside bathing season. Approximate position.

name: El Saler (Valencia)
notes: Summer E sea breeze onshore; W poniente offshore. Dune protected area, use marked access. Approximate position.

name: Castelldefels
notes: Kiting mainly outside summer bathing season; S-SW garbí onshore. N wind offshore. Approximate position.

name: Sa Ràpita (Mallorca)
notes: S-SW summer sea breeze onshore; N tramuntana offshore. Kite zone rules in summer. Approximate position.

name: Playa de Muro (Bay of Alcúdia)
notes: NE-E sea breeze onshore in bay; W-SW offshore. Kiting restricted to zones in summer. Approximate position.

name: El Cotillo Lagoons (Fuerteventura)
notes: Sheltered lagoons; N wind side-shore. The usual NE trade blows side-off here and gust rates it offshore. Reef, tide. Approximate position.

name: Playa de Somo (Cantabria)
notes: NE summer breeze and NW fronts side-on; S wind offshore. Surf beach, swell and currents. Approximate position.

name: Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer (Plage Est)
notes: SE-SW marin and sea breeze onshore; Mistral NW is offshore. Long Camargue beach. Approximate position.

name: Plage Napoléon (Port-Saint-Louis-du-Rhône)
notes: Shallow water in E-SE and SW winds; Mistral NW offshore. Gulf of Fos shipping nearby. Approximate position.

name: Le Barcarès
notes: E marin onshore; Tramontane NW is offshore here, ride the Leucate lagoon instead. Approximate position.

name: Lido de Sète (Villeroy)
notes: SE marin and SW sea breeze side-on; Tramontane NW offshore. Long sandy lido. Approximate position.

name: Poetto (Cagliari)
notes: Scirocco SE and SW side-on; Mistral NW offshore. Kite corridor at the Quartu end. Approximate position.

name: Chia (Su Giudeu)
notes: Scirocco SE and W winds; Mistral NW side-off and not rated. Protected dunes, summer swimmers. Approximate position.

name: Putzu Idu (Sinis)
notes: Mistral NW side-shore; Capo Mannu wave spot nearby for experts. Rocks at bay ends. Approximate position.

name: Torre Canne (Puglia)
notes: Maestrale NW side-shore, NE onshore; SW offshore. Rocky patches along shore. Approximate position.

name: Punta Prosciutto (Porto Cesareo)
notes: Ionian side; W-NW maestrale side-on, S scirocco onshore. Marine reserve rules apply. Approximate position.

name: Tombolo della Giannella (Orbetello)
notes: Libeccio SW and Maestrale NW side-on; SE offshore. Long sandy tombolo, summer kite zones. Approximate position.

name: Halikounas (Corfu)
notes: Summer NW meltemi side-shore by Korission lagoon; E wind offshore. Remote beach. Approximate position.

name: Afiartis (Chicken Bay, Karpathos)
notes: Strong NW meltemi blows side-off here and gust rates it offshore. Gusty; ride only with rescue. Approximate position.

name: Ammoudara (Heraklion, Crete)
notes: Summer N-NW meltemi onshore; S wind offshore. Hotel beach, swimmers in summer. Approximate position.

name: Monolithi (Preveza)
notes: Long Ionian beach; summer W-NW thermal onshore, E wind offshore. Approximate position.

name: Tourlida (Mesolongi)
notes: Causeway into the lagoon with shallow flat water in summer thermals. Shore facing varies. Approximate position.

name: Kilyos (Istanbul)
notes: Black Sea beach; NE poyraz onshore, S lodos offshore. Swell and currents. Approximate position.

name: Lady's Mile (Limassol)
notes: E-SE winds onshore; W thermal is offshore on this shore. Akrotiri military area nearby.

name: Mellieħa Bay (Għadira)
notes: NE gregale and NW onshore in winter; SW offshore. Bathing zone in summer. Approximate position.

name: Shkorpilovtsi
notes: Long Black Sea beach; NE and SE winds onshore, W offshore. Approximate position.

name: Kranevo
notes: Black Sea beach north of Varna; NE winds onshore, W offshore. Busy in summer. Approximate position.

name: Mamaia Nord (Năvodari)
notes: Black Sea; NE and SE winds onshore, W offshore. Busy resort beach in summer. Approximate position.
